llm.summary: WING, in the laggards lane, was stopped out with negative excess return, classified as an idiosyncratic break with clean process.
llm.root_cause: WING, in the laggards lane, was stopped out with negative excess return, classified as an idiosyncratic break with clean process.
llm.lesson: WING's reversal signal failed; the pick broke down further, indicating a conditioning gap.
llm.engines_credit: The laggards engine signalled a reversal, but the move continued down, so the reversal engine is the laggard here.
alternate_explanations: A Consumer Discretionary sector selloff may have overwhelmed the reversal signal.
Company-specific negative news could have caused the further decline.
missing_evidence: Details of the laggards reversal signal

signal_hypotheses.feature: Risk-adjusted excess return of laggards entries conditioned on sector trend
signal_hypotheses.measurement: Compare 10-day excess returns of laggards entries when sector is declining versus rising
signal_hypotheses.expected_direction: Laggards should have higher excess returns when sector is rising, indicating conditioning matters
signal_hypotheses.falsifier: If excess returns are similar regardless of sector trend, sector conditioning adds no value.
